name: LegalInk AI — Inka
description: Inka gives Claude users access to Indian legal Q&A grounded in BNS/BNSS 2023, instant reply drafting for GST/IT/legal notices, and BNS section lookup replacing old IPC/CrPC references. Built for advocates, CAs, and corporate legal teams across India.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LegalInk AI — Inka to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LegalInk AI — Inka to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.legalink.co.in/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LegalInk AI — Inka MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LegalInk AI — Inka provides these MCP tools: inka_chat, reply_to_notice, bns_lookup, and explore_inka.
